name: Hands-on Activity
description: A lesson built around doing: vocabulary, steps, an activity with timing and grouping, discussion, and a link to real life. For labs, projects and group work.
audience: Practical sessions, experiments and group activities.

signals.why: your words describe an activity or experiment
the topic is a skill students perform

slides.guidance: Lesson title for {topic} and a short subtitle that names the class level.
What students will do and what they will be able to explain after {topic}.
Words students need before starting {topic}, each with a plain meaning.
The steps students follow for {topic}, in order, with the safety or setup note where it matters.
The task: clear instructions, minutes, and whether students work alone, in pairs or groups.
Questions that make students explain what they saw and why.
Where {topic} shows up outside the classroom.
What was done, what was found, and what to remember.
